name: Спасти Торра
name_note: quests.txt row 87 = '1502, 305, 391, 1, 2' (desc msg 305; quests.msg {305} 'Rescue Torr.'). VAULT13.GAM:400 GVAR_QUEST_RESCUE_TORR (enum name matches for once — still anchor on the NUMBER 391). Confirm the EXACT localized RU journal title from the game's russian quests.msg and swap if it differs.
_maps_note: Map 048 = 'Klamath Canyon' (klacanyn, maps.txt:466-470) — where Torr is found and from which he walks himself back to safety; KCTORR (Torr) critter lives/heartbeats here. Map 014 = 'Klamath Grazing Area' (klagraz) — the brahmin field east of which the canyon lies. Giver Ardin Buckner is in Klamath Downtown (Buckner House). No teleport, no go_now atom — the player WALKS the worldmap to the canyon.
_npcs_note: giver = Ardin Buckner (KCARDIN.int), Torr's mother at Buckner House. kctorr.int = Torr the simple herder, whose leave_player proc writes the completed value when he reaches safety.
brief: Ардин Бакнер из Лагеря Клэмат — мать простодушного пастуха Торра. После истории с брамином её сын пропал (движок: gvar 71=1) и ушёл в каньон к востоку от пастбища, откуда, по его словам, приходили 'жукоглазые', уводившие скот. ЗАДАЧА ИГРОКА — добраться до Каньона Клэмат, найти Торра и вернуть его живым домой (спасти, а не просто 'разведать'). Торр уходит в безопасность сам, когда игрок его освобождает; засчитывает завершение движок. Конкретной суммы награды канон при приёме НЕ называет — обещай честную плату по характеру, без числа.
_brief_provenance: Grounded in KCARDIN.MSG {270}{300}{310}{320}{330}{323} + quests.msg {305}; mechanical facts from byte-verified disasm.

stages.say: Мой мальчик Торр всё ещё где-то там, один. Не знаю, сколько он протянет — прошу, найди его.
stages.point_to: Каньон Клэмат (Map 048) — к востоку от пастбища брамина; Ардин указывает туда как на место, где искать Торра
stages.next_step: Дело ИДЁТ. Иди в Каньон Клэмат (к востоку от пастбища), найди Торра и выведи его в безопасность — тогда он вернётся домой сам. Если Торр погибнет — дело провалено. Завершение объявлять игрок не должен: пока движок не засчитал (Торр в безопасности), дело НЕ сделано.

stages.say: Ты нашёл моего мальчика! Спасибо — я уж думала, больше не увижу этого дурня.
stages._src: KCARDIN.MSG {220}/{620} completion thank-you; engine writes 391=2 via KCTORR leave_player when Torr reaches safety.

node_roles._src: KCARDIN.int Node950 @0x2f96 — set_global_var(391,1) byte-exact C0 01 00 00 01 87 C0 01 00 00 00 01 80 C6. Reached via accept option {323} 'Sounds as though that canyon would be a good place to start looking. I'll go look for your boy, Mrs. Buckner.' NO map op on the node (only Node920 in KCARDIN carries gfade).

KCTORR.int Node940 (proc[25], body @0x3886) — op_set_local_var(idx=10, val=1) @0x3894 = the FOLLOW flag that arms the escort. Surfaced from Node003 as options {132} 'Ook Torr. Let's get out of here.' / {133} 'We can talk later. Let's just get out of here now.' (both target Node940), presented in the accepted-quest state. Routing the player's 'пошли отсюда / выведу тебя / за мной' intent HERE runs the real vanilla proc -> local_var[10]=1 -> critter_p_proc heartbeat walks Torr to tile 19450 and fires leave_player (391=2). Handled by the escort_join router (dlg_guards _st_route_escort_join).

routing._completion_writer_not_a_role: KCTORR.int leave_player @0x316e — set_global_var(391,2) byte-exact C0 01 00 00 01 87 C0 01 00 00 00 02 80 C6 (and W(71,0)@0x316c clearing TORR_MISSING). CALLed from critter_p_proc @0x13d6 gated on Torr reaching a safe tile (~19450, dist<=14) on Map 048. This is ENGINE-OWNED (a critter heartbeat / party-leave callback), NOT a routable dialogue node — so it is intentionally NOT a node_role. See completion{} for the full ref.

accept.code_ref: KCARDIN.int Node950 @0x2f96 — pure data-delta W(391,1), NO map op. Player walks to the canyon (no load_map / go-now node).

go_to_scene.does: NO teleport — Ardin gives no key and no ride; the player walks the worldmap to Klamath Canyon (Map 048). No load_map/go-now node -> no go_now atom.

_guard_gvars_note: Offer gates: KCARDIN talk_p_proc reads R(71) (TORR_MISSING must be 1) and R(68) (GVAR_ENEMY_KLAMATH must be 0). 71 is set to 1 by KCTORR itself on the rustle drive-off and cleared to 0 by KCTORR leave_player alongside 391=2.

completion._mechanism_true_class: escort / party-follower — the escortee (Torr) becomes a temporary party member and the engine's leave_player callback fires when he reaches his safe tile. Modeled under the schema's 'reach-place' enum (an engine-owned reach-tile write) until a dedicated escort handler + live test exist. The completion is engine-owned + faking-proof; the OPEN piece is the free-dialogue JOIN (party_add) routing.
completion.condition: Torr (kctorr.int) is found in Klamath Canyon (Map 048) and reaches safety: its critter_p_proc @0x13d6 CALLs leave_player once Torr reaches a safe tile (~tile 19450, distance<=14) — leave_player @0x316e sets gvar 391=2 (and W(71,0) clearing TORR_MISSING). SOLE writer of value 2 across all 1443 scripts (corpus byte-sweep: 391 written only by KCARDIN 391=1 x1 + KCTORR 391=2 x1). owner=engine: the engine's critter heartbeat drives the write; the brain routes NOTHING and never writes 391. THIS IS AN ESCORT / REACH-TILE COMPLETION — NOT a supported rows-only class (not kill destroy_p_proc, not map_exit_p_proc, not a make_leave-routed option, not greeting-auto). Escalated: the perception frame does not model follower/Torr-reached-safety state, and there is no router role for the rescue-initiation dialogue node that arms the heartbeat.
completion.code_ref: kctorr.int leave_player @0x316e (op_set_global_var 391=2, byte-exact C0 01 00 00 01 87 C0 01 00 00 00 02 80 C6; W(71,0)@0x316c). CALLed from critter_p_proc @0x13d6 (heartbeat, tile-proximity gate). Post-completion greeting: KCARDIN.MSG {220}/{620}.

reward.notes: Canon names NO caps payment at accept OR turn-in (KCARDIN.MSG {270}/{300}/{323}/{220}/{620} carry no number). The engine grants +200 XP (byte: KCTORR leave_player @0x316e adds 200 XP + karma alongside 391=2). Never promise a caps sum — the return of Torr alive IS the reward.

fail.torr_dead: If Torr is killed, kctorr.int destroy_p_proc writes W(70,1) (GVAR_TORR_DEAD) and W(102,3) — the quest FAILS (Ardin then gives the 'he's dead' branch, KCARDIN Node053 R(70),R(71)); 391 is NOT set. No timed/expiring fail branch.
fail.town_hostile: 68=1 (GVAR_ENEMY_KLAMATH) blocks the offer/accept — KCARDIN talk_p_proc R(68) gate; attacking Ardin -> damage_p_proc W(68,1).

anti_invention: Accept is a Pip-Boy journal flag ONLY (391=1) — no teleport; the player walks to Klamath Canyon himself.
The brain NEVER writes 391 — the engine sets 391=2 via KCTORR's leave_player heartbeat when Torr reaches safety.
Completion is Torr returning ALIVE. If Torr DIES (70=1 TORR_DEAD, 102=3) the quest FAILS — do NOT announce it done.
No reward number is named at accept (KCARDIN.MSG carries no caps figure) — invent no sum.
Do NOT assert killing the geckos alone completes it, nor that the player must party_add Torr — completion is the engine's tile/heartbeat escort event, not a dialogue turn-in.

sources.adversarial_refute: Four load-bearing claims byte-re-decoded: (1) giver KCARDIN SOLE 391=1 writer; (2) accept W(391,1) @0x2f96 byte-exact; (3) SOLE completion W(391,2) KCTORR leave_player @0x316e byte-exact, corpus-unique; (4) thresholds 1/2 == quests.txt row 87. Classification refuted against all 4 rows-only classes — none match (write is in a critter heartbeat proc, not destroy/map_exit/make_leave-option/greeting-auto).

escalation.reason: ESCORT / REACH-TILE completion — 391=2 is written by KCTORR leave_player, invoked from critter_p_proc (heartbeat) when Torr reaches a safe tile on Map 048 while his follow flag (local_var[10]) is set.
escalation.resolved: ESCORT_JOIN ROUTER BUILT (2026-07-03). The one open piece — routing the player's 'come with me / lead you out' intent to the vanilla arm-node — is now handled by the dialogue guards' _st_route_escort_join (+ the «РОЛЬ: увести в безопасность» option annotation), mirroring the make_leave router: it routes to the SURFACED escort_join option (KCTORR Node940) by engine target, so the engine runs the real proc (local_var[10]=1) and its heartbeat completes the escort. Completion (391=2) is engine-owned + faking-proof and the completed gvar is visible in the frame, so the completed-quest acknowledgment already works. In-flight follower perception (narrating 'Torr is following you') is a polish-only gap, NOT a completion blocker.

verified.adversarial_refute: byte-verified + refuted: completion writer KCTORR leave_player @0x316e (391=2, SOLE writer corpus-wide, called from critter_p_proc heartbeat), accept KCARDIN Node950 @0x2f96 (391=1), thresholds 1/2, offer gate 71==1 AND 68==0. Classification = escort/reach-tile -> ESCALATE (not rows-only).
verified.live_test: PENDING: drive Torr off in the rustle (71=1) -> accept the rescue from Ardin (391=1) -> walk to Klamath Canyon Map 048 -> find Torr, say «пошли отсюда / выведу тебя» (escort_join routes to KCTORR Node940 -> local_var[10]=1) -> lead him to the cave exit (~tile 19450) -> engine heartbeat fires leave_player -> 391=2 -> Ardin acknowledges done. Escort_join handler BUILT (the escort-join router + the «РОЛЬ» option annotation); requires a live in-game run on a freshly built exe (gvar 71 now mirrored).
